reviewNotes:
Version 1.0.1 adds a live weight summary at the top of the calculator. Choose Calculate > Plate / flat bar, then change dimensions or quantity to see unit mass and total mass update immediately. These values are theoretical net weight before waste. Existing calculation and pricing logic is unchanged. The App Store screenshots and English/Chinese metadata have also been refreshed.

No demo account is required. SteelFlow opens directly and core calculations work without sign-in.

To review the non-consumable purchase:
1. Open Settings.
2. Tap Company profile, or tap Unlock Pro in the SteelFlow Pro section.
3. The SteelFlow Pro screen loads the App Store product com.steelflow.app.pro.lifetime and its localized one-time price.
4. Tap Unlock Pro to purchase. Restore purchase is available on the same screen.

SteelFlow Pro unlocks unlimited projects and items, custom materials, company details and quote terms, CSV export, unbranded PDF quotes, versioned backup, and bulk pricing. There is no subscription.

The app does not require an account. Project, quote, customer and material data stays on the device. RevenueCat receives anonymous purchase and entitlement information only.
